<function name="isfunction" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns if the passed object is a <page>function</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="variable" type="any">The variable to perform the type check for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the variable is a <page>function</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
